description: Returns one player's profile by id: name, team, position, injury status, jersey and cross-system ids, plus per-season data on Basic and above. Use it to check a player's current team or injury status. Free plan (profile fields only; season data needs Basic).

player_id.description: GridIron player id, "First Last#POS", matched case-insensitively. Defenses are "Team Name#DST". Unsure of the id? Call search_players first.
player_id.title: Player Id

season.description: Only include this season's data. Default: every season.
season.title: Season

name: get_player

error.description: Present only when the call failed: what went wrong.

free_plan.description: Present on free keys: what the free plan includes.

ids.description: Other systems' ids (gsis, pfr, pff, nfl, espn, sleeper) from the nflverse crosswalk.

note.description: A sentence for the user saying which plan is needed.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure reason, e.g. basic_required or pro_required.

required_plan.description: The plan that unlocks this data: basic or pro.

seasons.description: Season year -> that season's data (Basic and above).

status.description: HTTP status of the failed API call.

vs_opponent.description: Team code -> career matchup history (Basic and above).

title: Player profile
